sentences: `tools/shader_ir.py` keeps VOP3 FP source modifiers (`neg(...)`, `|...|`, `-|...|`, `abs(...)`, and nested combinations) as `abs`/`neg` flags on `imm` and `fimm` operands so `abs` clears the sign bit first and `neg` flips it second (matching LLVM `AMDGPUInstPrinter.cpp::printOperandAndFPInputMods` and `llvm/test/MC/AMDGPU/vop3-modifiers.s`).

Until 2026-11-22, `-|1.0|` folded `-` into the float before `FAbs` (yielding `+1.0`), `neg(0x3f800000)` / `neg(1)` applied two's-complement integer negation (`-4.0f` / `0xffffffff` NaN instead of `-1.0f` / `0x80000001`), and `|0x...|` / `-|0x...|` dropped `abs`.
`tools/shader_meta.py` applies the same bit operations in `_imm_u32`.

Checked on the CPU by `tests/test_shader_ir.py`, `tests/test_shader_meta.py` and `tests/semantic/test_vop3_const_mods.py` (f32, f16, `v_fma_mix_f32`, `v_cmp_class_f32`, f64 SPIR-V structure); GPU-checked for `-\|-2.0\|`, `neg(0x3f800000)`, `\|0xbf800000\|` and f16 `-\|0x3c00\|` by `ps_vop3_const_mods.asm` (Tesla V100 (NVIDIA 580.95.05, Linux)).
